---
title: "Overview"
---

This project measures how stable the latent factors found in sepsis gene-expression
datasets are, and compares them across datasets. Six methods are fit to every dataset --
PCA, NMF, CoGAPS, sparse PCA (sPCA), ICA and WGCNA -- across random seeds and across their
rank or sparsity parameters. Stability, enrichment, projections and diagnostics are then
written to one SQLite database, which a Shiny app browses.

One [targets](https://books.ropensci.org/targets/) pipeline (`_targets.R`) does all of it,
with the heavy steps running as SLURM jobs through
[crew.cluster](https://wlandau.github.io/crew.cluster/):

1. **Matrices.** Each dataset's config says how to build its genes × samples matrix from
   the raw data ([Data](data.qmd)).
2. **Fits.** Each method's parameter grid is fit, one fit per grid row ([Methods](methods.qmd)).
3. **Ingestion.** Fits are compared with each other (stability), enriched, projected onto
   the other datasets and summarized, then written to the database ([Database](database.qmd)).
4. **App.** A Shiny app browses the database ([Launching the app](app.qmd)).

targets re-runs only what a change invalidates: editing one dataset's config rebuilds that
dataset only, editing one method rebuilds that method only ([Running the workflow](workflow.qmd)).

## Layout

| Path | What |
|---|---|
| `_targets.R` | the pipeline: sources the code, builds the targets for every dataset in `config/pipeline.yml` |
| `config/pipeline.yml` | datasets to build, data root, DB path, SLURM resources per method |
| `config/<dataset>_config.yml` | one dataset: data paths and each method's parameter grid |
| `config/dataset_families.yml` | which datasets are timepoints of the same cohort |
| `R/methods/` | one file per method: fit function, `<name>_registry` (fitting) and `<name>_ingest` (ingestion) |
| `R/lib/` | config reading, data paths, matrix loading, method discovery |
| `R/lib/ingest/` | the computations behind the DB: similarity, factor/module pairs, redundancy, ICASSO, pattern drivers, gene-id mapping |
| `R/targets/` | target factories, SLURM controllers, ingestion, enrichment, projections, diagnostics, DB writers |
| `R/ingest_jobs/` | the enrichment and projectR job functions |
| `R/db/` | the DB schema (`schema.sql`, `views.sql`) and `open_stability_db()` |
| `R/preprocessing/` | one matrix-building script per dataset |
| `R/de/` | the differential-expression analysis (outside the pipeline) |
| `app/` | the Shiny app |
| `run_pipeline.sbatch` | runs `tar_make()` as a SLURM job |
| `docs/` | this site |
